describes: `403` · `ACCOUNT_SUSPENDED`. The signed-in account is suspended; the app routes to the on-hold screen. Contract-only: `services/hg` answers a suspended account with `ACCOUNT_NOT_ACTIVE` at sign-in (`error_account_not_active`) and `SESSION_REVOKED` at refresh (`error_session_revoked`); handle all three.

error.message: Your account is on hold. Contact support.
